vibe_rationale: Deep participatory community with real self-expression and art, but a commerce-free culture fails the brand-friendly trait.
fit_notes: Adult, highly engaged community (mostly 22 to 35 in the 2020 census) that is hard for brands to reach under its no-sponsor principles. Only unbranded or volunteer-led contributions would fit, so it is a low activation priority; it is a New Zealand event.
